reason: The text contains only four named characters: Moses (מֹשֶׁה) - leader of Israel; Pharaoh (פַרְעֹה) - leader of Egypt; Aaron (אַהֲרֹן) - high priest and leader; and God/YHWH (יְהוָה) - the ultimate authority. All other persons referenced (servants, people, magicians, animals) are mentioned collectively or generically without individual names. No named character in the text lacks a leadership role.
